tables.head: Invention (picture)
rows: It carries people and goods quickly over long distances.
We would travel for days or weeks by road or ship.
Doctors use it to give medicines and vaccines and to take blood.
Giving injections and vaccines would be difficult and more people would stay ill.
It tells us the time, so we can plan school, work and prayers.
We would guess the time from the sun and often be late.
A computer we can carry: we can write, study and find information anywhere.
We would work on big desktop computers or only on paper.
